name: airport
description: Attach an Arrow Flight server as a DuckDB catalog. Once attached, schemas, tables, and SQL operations on the remote server become accessible like any local database — joins, filters, aggregates, and (when the server supports the corresponding Flight RPCs) INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE. Pass the connection target either inline as parameters or by reference to a previously-created `airport` secret.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Arrow Flight server URI, e.g. `grpc://host:8815` or `grpc+tls://host:8815`. Required when not attaching by secret name.

parameters.name: auth_token
parameters.description: Bearer token sent in the gRPC Authorization header. Recommended via `CREATE SECRET` rather than inline so it's not stored in query text.

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.description: Optional filter string passed to the server's `ListFlights` RPC during catalog discovery. Server-defined semantics.

examples.description: Attach by secret name (recommended — keeps credentials out of query text)
Attach inline without a secret (good for ad-hoc connections to unauthenticated servers)
Mutate a remote table — works only when the Flight server implements `DoPut` for the operation
